AttendanceRegisterEntryDto.description:
One row of the tenant-wide attendance register/currently-present view — see
MyCondo.Domain.Features.Payroll.AttendanceRecords.AttendanceRegisterEntry for the rationale.

AuthenticatedUserDto.description:
Permissions holds only tenant-wide grants (from role assignments with no
        building scope) — this is exactly what the JWT's `perm` claim carries, so the two stay in sync.
        Building-scoped grants live separately in BuildingPermissions (the JWT's
        `bperm` claim) precisely so a permission held only for Building A can't be mistaken for a
        tenant-wide grant that would also apply to Building B. See ADR-014.

AuthResponse.description:
The public wire shape of Register/Login/Refresh — everything AuthTokensDto carries except the
refresh token, which never leaves the server as a JSON field (see RefreshTokenCookie).

BuildingPermissionGrant.description: A permission granted to the user, scoped to exactly one building.

CreateUserCommand.description:
Creates a user within the caller's own tenant. string? CreateUserCommand.InitialPassword is optional — when
omitted, a random temporary password is generated and returned once in CreateUserResult
for the administrator to relay to the new user out-of-band. TenantId is deliberately not a field
here — it is always resolved from `ICurrentUserProvider`, never accepted from the client.

CreateUserResult.description:
string? CreateUserResult.TemporaryPassword is populated only when the caller did not supply
        `InitialPassword` — it is never persisted or retrievable again after this response.

FinancialSummaryDto.description:
TotalBilled and TotalCollected are period-flow values strictly within [FromDate, ToDate].
            TotalOutstanding, UnpaidInvoiceCount, PartiallyPaidInvoiceCount, and OverdueInvoiceCount are
            current-snapshot values as of DateOnly FinancialSummaryDto.AsOfDate, independent of the FromDate/ToDate window —
            do not treat TotalOutstanding as constrained to the reporting period.

GeneratorOperationalReportLineDto.description:
One line per generator, covering the spec's "Runtime / Fuel usage / Cost per hour"
            reports (§5.13) in a single query rather than three near-identical ones.

fuelConsumed.description: Presentation-only convenience — not stored, derived from already-authoritative fields.

OccupancyRegistrationSecuritySummaryDto.description:
List-row shape for the security-facing directory — see
            OccupancyRegistrationSecurityViewDto for the full detail shape and masking rules.

OccupancyRegistrationSecurityViewDto.description:
Deliberately restricted view of an OccupancyRegistration
for security staff — operational information only (name, photo, unit, occupancy/access status,
approved household/workers/vehicles). Never includes National ID, passport, permanent address,
email, or any identity-document/lease data — see `GetOccupancyRegistrationSecurityViewQueryHandler`.

PlatformAuthenticatedUserDto.description:
Deliberately has no TenantId field — unlike
AuthenticatedUserDto, there is no tenant
dimension to carry. A Platform identity is not a tenant member. See mycondo-docs ADR-019.

PlatformLoginCommand.description:
Deliberately carries no TenantId/Organization/OrganizationCode/TenantSlug field — not optional,
structurally absent. A Platform SuperAdmin authenticates without ever declaring a tenant. See
mycondo-docs ADR-019 and the approved Phase 1 blueprint, §5 ("Platform Authentication").

ReceivablesAgeingReportDto.description:
Always 5 fixed buckets (Current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 91+ days overdue), computed from
            remaining balance as of DateOnly ReceivablesAgeingReportDto.AsOfDate — never the invoice's original amount.

RecordStockMovementCommand.description:
MovementKind must be one of "Receipt", "Issue", "EmptyReturn" — Adjustment goes through
            `RecordStockAdjustmentCommand` instead, since it needs a mandatory reason and the
            `gascylinder.approve` permission (checked at the endpoint, a materially more sensitive action).

RegisterFlatOwnerCommand.description:
Atomically registers a new Flat Owner: creates the shared `Resident` party record (Owner type,
with the full identity/contact/family-professional profile captured by the registration wizard) and
grants the first `FlatOwnership` in one operation. Deliberately does not go through a
Draft/Submitted/Verified approval lifecycle like Tenant Registration — ownership registration has no
concrete approval requirement, so this both creates and finalizes the record; additional owned Flats
are added afterward via the existing `CreateFlatOwnershipCommand` (ownership-specific operation,
not folded into this one).

SecuritySummaryDto.description:
Tenant-wide only — `AccessSession` and `Parcel` have no BuildingId of their own
            (one front gate/desk serves the whole property), so no buildingId filter is offered here. Excludes
            Payroll's Staff Attendance entirely — that stays Payroll's domain, not Security's, per UX-5's
            approved module-boundary decision.
